Favorable: don't let him stack safely. All-in with R whenever he overextends, fear his flight dash, interrupt his breath channel with E, and punish his immobility early before he scales.

Dodge her Q and avoid extended trades her E spam wins. Burst her with Q, E and W before she ramps, turn away from her ult, and out-roam her.

Heavily Vex-favored: dodge her Q to deny the reset, W the moment she dashes, zone with E and out-poke her. Zhonya's for her ult.

His Q dash procs your passive; fear him before he can E away. Wait out his untargetable E and place your E where he lands. Poke him before level 3; Zhonya's for his ult.
His E charge procs your passive; W cancels it mid-dash. Dodge his tornado and taunt range; he's hard to burst so poke and roam, match his roams with R and buy Void Staff.

Skill lane between artillery mages: dodge his skillshots, and your R all-in far exceeds his since he can't escape. Spread vs his ult.
Her Q resets constantly proc your passive. W when she dashes at you, deny free passive stacking near you, and place E on minions she wants to reset on. Zhonya's vs her all-in.
His hammer leap procs your passive: W and kite back. Dodge his gated Q in cannon form and match his poke. Early armor, later Zhonya's.
Bully him hard pre-6 since he's weak. After 6, every Riftwalk procs your passive; fear and burst him when he blinks in. Banshee's blocks his silence.
You hard counter her: every Shunpo procs your passive. E on her daggers, fear her ult, poke with Q; she struggles to find any engage.
Her W dash procs your passive; fear her before she returns and place E on her return pad. Walk out of her chain range after fearing. Banshee's for safety.
Her E claw recast procs your passive: W as she arrives. Wait out her self-tomb, trade Q evenly vs hers, Banshee's blocks her W root. Your passive gives you the edge.
Skill lane: dodge her binding to remove her kill pressure. When her Q is down, R in for the kill. Banshee's blocks a binding; out-roam her.
His spell shield blocks poke; auto to pop it first. Buy Quicksilver vs his ult and clear voidlings with E. He'll perma-push, so roam with R and out-impact the map.
Her leap, dash and ult all proc your passive. W fears her and kills her dogs; place E defensively when she ults. Zhonya's vs burst.
Skill lane: dodge her root, track her real body, match her poke with Q and E. W to shield and fear when she ults in.
Farm-oriented skill lane: track the ball, trade evenly, spread vs her ult, push and roam with R instead of trying to kill. Banshee's for her ult.
His W stun dash procs your passive: W after the stun lands. Cast from the side vs his shield, respect early poke, then outscale him in mid-game fights.
Her dash procs your passive; fear her before she combos. Stay away from walls vs her ult and E between you and terrain. Zhonya's vs her burst.
Skill lane: stand behind minions vs his Q, fear can cancel his ult teleport, and your R combo kills him before he ramps. Banshee's for his root.
His E dashes proc your passive; fear him mid-dash and when he closes for W. Respect him if he steals your ult. Buy Morellonomicon for anti-heal.
Pure skill lane: dodge her stun, match her poke, Zhonya's vs her ult, and land your combo first; both of you are gank-prone.
Skill lane: avoid fighting on her worked ground, dodge her E into W combo, match poke and her roams with your R. First combo wins.
His Q dash procs your passive; W when he jumps on you. Track and ping his wall roams, follow with R. Early armor into Zhonya's.
Her rocket jump procs your passive: fear her when she lands and place E there. Hold fear after her knockback if needed. Zhonya's vs her bomb burst.
Favorable: dodge gold card, out-range his Q, and he's very vulnerable to your all-in. Match or punish his ult roams. Banshee's blocks a card.

Vex-favored: dodge his Q, all-in with R since he can't escape, fear to interrupt his laser. Banshee's vs his knock-up.

Bait his pool with E, then all-in while it's down. Buy Morellonomicon, poke to outpace his sustain, and get leads early since he outscales.
Heavily Vex-favored: dodge his Q and simply all-in with R; he has no escape. Banshee's vs his stun, fear to interrupt his ult.
His E spam procs your passive constantly: W when he dashes in, place E on minions he dashes through, and play around his wind wall. Early armor.
His E, Q3 and ult dashes proc your passive. W his E engage and put E on his body marker to fear his return. Armor into Zhonya's.
His ult dash procs your passive: W the moment he appears behind you. Track shadows, poke when his W is down. Armor into Zhonya's.
Her portal jump procs your passive; place E where she returns. Dodge her bubble, fear her when she ults in, and R all-in since she returns to a fixed spot. Banshee's blocks a bubble.
His satchel jump counts as a dash. Dodge his Q, all-in with R since he has little escape, Banshee's blocks a spell; out-roam his tower focus.

general: Vex punishes mobility: any enemy dash marks them with Gloom, and her Doom-empowered next ability fears and interrupts dashes, so lanes against dash-heavy champions (Yasuo, Yone, Katarina, Irelia, Ekko) are where she shines, while long-range artillery mages, heavy sustain and spell shields are harder. In lane, poke with Q (ideally E then Q then an auto to pop Gloom) and don't waste Doom on random poke; save it to fear an engage, often by W'ing point-blank when a diver jumps on you. From level 6, Shadow Surge all-ins (R, recast, W, Q, auto, Ignite) kill most squishies from about 70% HP, and E before R adds a Gloom mark for extra damage; wait a moment before recasting R so they waste Flash first. Use R to roam and out-impact immobile mid laners, and buy Zhonya's (Banshee's against key skillshots) since diving in leaves you exposed.
